name: BuiltByMe

sources.title: Homepage — live indie maker directory with weekly upvote competition and leaderboard
Pricing — Free $0/launch (5 weekly slots, nofollow), Launch $9 (dofollow + instant), Sponsor $19, Directory Boost add-ons

conditions: Free plan is limited to 5 submission slots per week — queue applies when full
Free listings get a NoFollow link only; DoFollow requires the $9 Launch plan
Free launches still get a permanent listing and compete in the weekly leaderboard
requirements: Indie-built product — 'a home for those who build on their own'
Products compete in a weekly upvote leaderboard; #1 wins a newsletter feature + X shoutout
Paid tiers: Launch $9/launch (instant, dofollow, free review blog post), Sponsor $19/30 days sidebar
preparation: Product name, URL, tagline/description, and category (AI tools, SaaS, dev tools, productivity, marketing, design, analytics)
Decide free vs $9 Launch — free still enters the weekly competition
If timing matters, check whether the week's 5 free slots are taken
workflow: Open https://builtbyme.io/submit?plan=free (or /submit and pick a plan)
Create/sign in to an account and fill in product details
Free plan waits for a weekly slot; Launch $9 publishes instantly
Product appears in Current Rankings for the week and accrues community upvotes
Weekly #1 gets the newsletter feature and X shoutout regardless of plan
watchFor: Free-plan links are NoFollow — limited SEO value; dofollow is the $9 paid tier's main selling point
Free slots cap at 5/week — submit early in the week (competition week runs Mon–Sun, e.g. Sep 21–27)
Directory Boost ($49-$119 'guaranteed DR') is a separate paid submission service, not needed for a listing
Low overall scale (~18k visits YTD per its own Umami stats) — treat as a community/competition play, not a traffic source
countsAsLive: The product has a public /products/<slug> page on builtbyme.io and appears in the current week rankings or all-time listings
unknowns: Exact fields on the submit form (not fetched; behind sign-in)
Whether free submissions are manually reviewed before appearing
How ties/upvote fraud are handled on the weekly leaderboard
